summary: Frontend-only verification of ZCOS/Zebulon constellation landing at https://zcos-migration.preview.emergentagent.com. All acceptance criteria PASS: WebGL canvas mounts inside data-testid='zebulon-constellation-canvas', the procedural nebula backdrop (violet/magenta/blue clouds) is clearly visible along with a multi-layer starfield and glowing constellation links radiating from the central ZAR node to every galaxy (ZENITH, ZETA, ZENO, ZYNC, TOXIN, ZMAP, ZYLO). The sky is ANIMATED: two canvas screenshots captured ~3.2s apart produced different md5 hashes and different file sizes, confirming the shader plane is advancing over time. No JS pageerrors were emitted. The already-approved UI is intact: top-left ZCOS wordmark + 'ZEBULON COMMANDER' + COMMAND pill; bottom dock shows 'COMMANDER · ONLINE' with tabs CHAT / UPLOAD / ALL MEMORY / ALL KNOWLEDGE / ALL PROJECTS, the central mic with 'TAP TO TALK WITH ZAR', plus HISTORY and ADMIN ACCESS. Center legend (Nebula, Constellation line, Navigation beacon) and 'TAP A STAR TO EXPLORE' hint are present.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking: a single 404 resource (likely favicon/asset) is logged on load — cosmetic only, does not affect landing.
Non-blocking: headless swiftshader emits 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' perf warnings; expected in preview environment and does not affect rendering.

Note: canvas.getImageData sampling from an off-canvas 2D context returned all-black (WebGL context without preserveDrawingBuffer taints/blocks read). This is a measurement artifact only — the actual Playwright canvas screenshot clearly shows the nebula, stars, and constellation links.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing is served static at the preview URL (no auth, no backend). Use viewport 430x900, wait_until='domcontentloaded' + explicit sleep (networkidle never settles due to continuous WebGL rendering). To verify animation, compare md5 of two element.screenshot() captures of the inner <canvas> taken ~3s apart — this is the reliable method since getImageData against a WebGL canvas returns black in headless.
